Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-generalsolo022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/generalsolo.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Light/large/generalsolo.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). During battle, may use 1 Force to play an Interrupt from your Reserve Deck (then place that card out of play). Once per turn, may take a non-Interrupt card with 'door' in game text into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[General Solo (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 9 July 2018<ref name="img-generalsolo6d7b3a4">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/generalsolo.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6d7b3a40f529171f7399cff382887d6260118998 commit 6d7b3a4] (9 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Light/large/generalsolo.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). '''What changed:''' the game text was rewritten (compare the texts below); the errata mark “E” now prints at bottom right (the previous image printed none). A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “•General Solo”. Text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. * '''PC-E2''' ([[General Solo (V) (Errata 2)]]): PC card image uploaded 31 July 2022<ref name="img-generalsoloab74419">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/generalsolo.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Light/large/generalsolo.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the errata mark “E” → “E1”; the bottom margin “•General Solo” → “General Solo” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “General Solo”. Once per turn, may take a non-Interrupt card with 'door' in game text into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
